ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 早上好！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 谢谢你告诉我们

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我会努力的！请多多关照！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我只会往前看

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我！要吃遍全国！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 全国演出！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我也一直期待着由乃同学的新曲。
正如小阿拉蕾说的，收到的吉他乐句也很帅气

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
别在意。
因为听小阿拉蕾唱歌很开心呀

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那么各位。为了接下来的演出，请大家伸出手

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……我们MewType
一定能够改变

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我也非常喜欢。
吉他的那部分特别出彩……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 下次直播，弹点什么好呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 在乐队练习之前，先把学校的作业做完吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好好吃饭才能有活力。多吃点补充能量吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 呜，好冷……！昨天明明还很暖和的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 经常和小阿拉蕾一起玩的公园里，樱花开得很漂亮哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 苦夏的时候食欲会下降……？是真的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊，夏日祭典的通知……要不要邀请大家一起去呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 吃什么都觉得很美味……这就是食欲之秋吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 运动会我还是有点期待的。因为我并不讨厌运动

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 肉包子们，在我到家之前请一定要保持热腾腾的状态……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 放在口袋里的暖宝宝烫得像着火了一样……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好期待啊，圣诞火鸡……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 年糕……吃几个才不算过分呢……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 把巧克力带到学校去没关系吧……？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 马上就要演出了，再稍微练习一下吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 为了演出我可是吃了很多饭。现在万事俱备

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 早上好！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 谢谢你告诉我们

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我会努力的！请多多关照！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我只会往前看

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我！要吃遍全国！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 全国演出！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
我也一直期待着由乃同学的新曲。
正如小阿拉蕾说的，收到的吉他乐句也很帅气

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
别在意。
因为听小阿拉蕾唱歌很开心呀

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 那么各位。为了接下来的演出，请大家伸出手

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
……我们MewType
一定能够改变

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
我也非常喜欢。
吉他的那部分特别出彩……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 下次直播，弹点什么好呢？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 在乐队练习之前，先把学校的作业做完吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 好好吃饭才能有活力。多吃点补充能量吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 呜，好冷……！昨天明明还很暖和的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 经常和小阿拉蕾一起玩的公园里，樱花开得很漂亮哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 苦夏的时候食欲会下降……？是真的吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊，夏日祭典的通知……要不要邀请大家一起去呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 吃什么都觉得很美味……这就是食欲之秋吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 运动会我还是有点期待的。因为我并不讨厌运动

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 肉包子们，在我到家之前请一定要保持热腾腾的状态……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 放在口袋里的暖宝宝烫得像着火了一样……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 好期待啊，圣诞火鸡……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 年糕……吃几个才不算过分呢……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 把巧克力带到学校去没关系吧……？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 马上就要演出了，再稍微练习一下吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 为了演出我可是吃了很多饭。现在万事俱备
